01412 Gudgodah {gud-go:'-da:}

01413 的重複型 (取其"切割"之意); 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Gudgodah 2; 2

谷歌大 = "揮斬之地"
1) 以色列人在曠野漂流時駐紮地或所停留過的一個地方 (#申 10:7|)
record.edic_text:
01412 Gudgodah {gud-go'-daw}

by reduplication from 01413 (in the sense of cutting);; n pr loc

AV - Gudgodah 2; 2

Gudgodah = "the slashing place"
1) a station or stopping place of Israel in the wilderness wanderings
